about.title: How your files are handled
about.intro: Backsave for Revit converts a Revit file to an older Revit version. This page says what happens to your file and when it is deleted.

sent.title: When your file is sent
sent.body: The Revit version and the file type are read in your browser. Your file is only sent when you press Downgrade.

unfinished.what: An upload that was not finished

original.when: As soon as the conversion succeeds

failed.what: The original of a failed conversion
failed.when: 15 minutes after the failure, so you can choose to send it for review

output.what: The converted file and the list of removed elements
output.when: 1 hour after they are ready, or when you press Delete now

report.what: A file you chose to send for review
report.when: After 30 days or when you ask, whichever comes first. At most 20 GB are kept; the oldest go first.

cookies.title: Cookies and tracking
cookies.body: Backsave sets no tracking cookies and has no analytics or advertising. Your browser keeps your language choice and the ID of a running conversion, only so the page can pick up where it left off.

logs.title: Server logs
logs.body: Server logs never contain file names or file content.
